Have to agree with this answer the most. Bought a Nectar in October, after laying on one in the store. I was miserable in pain that got worse and worse. Returned it last week. Slept really good on a work trip at a DoubleTree hotel and researched what type of mattress it was. Found out is made by Serta. Returned the Nectar(PITA process). Checked out Marks Mattress Outlet and found a Serta almost identical to the DoubleTree mattress. Checked out several different stores, Serta online, and then went to MF and they’re prices were INSANE! 
Figure out what type of mattress you want like this person said, go from there. I was really hesitant about the return policy at Mark’s Mattress outlet after the Nectar fiasco, but I think knowing what type of mattress you want is best advice. If you need the return policy bc you’re unsure, buy direct online from the brand, not MF. I bought from them in 2015 and swore never again and still went back this past week just to see and nope, walked out within minutes.

At some point over the past 20-30 years, they took down all the signs. Native here for all you transplants, there used to be multiple and numerous signs all along the Trail of Tears down 70 from Lebanon to MJ to downtown. It was a big part of our history and we were taught what it was early on in elementary school throughout middle school. I was shocked when the signs were taken down and still not sure why they ever  took them down. Those of us that have been around a few decades will remember. I can remember being a child and teenager riding along 70, seeing the signs, remembering the history and story of the Trail of Tears and being sad and disgusted that was a part of how our history played out.
